questions.questionText:
The diagram shows an aircraft flying in a straight horizontal line at constant speed.
W is the weight of the aircraft.
L is the lift (upward force) due to air flow over the wings.
T is the thrust force due to the engine.
D is the air resistance (drag).
The diagram shows the direction of these forces.
D T
What are the relationships between the forces?

options.text: L = W and T = D
L = W and T is greater than D
L is greater than W and T = D
L is greater than W and T is greater than D

height
length

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows an air-filled rubber toy. A child sits on the toy and its volume decreases.
The temperature of the air in the toy does not change.
How does the air pressure in the toy change and why?
pressure reason

options.text: decreases air molecules move more slowly
decreases air molecules strike the rubber less frequently
increases air molecules move more quickly
increases air molecules strike the rubber more frequently

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows an electric heater being used to heat a beaker of water and an identical
beaker containing oil. Both are heated for one minute.
water oil
electric heater
The temperature of the water and the temperature of the oil increase steadily. The increase in
temperature of the oil is much greater than that of the water.
Why is this?

options.text: Oil has a higher boiling point than water.
Oil has a lower boiling point than water.
The oil has a larger thermal capacity than the water.
The oil has a smaller thermal capacity than the water.

questions.questionText: Which statement about the direction of a change of state is correct?

options.text: Evaporation is the reverse process to boiling.
Evaporation is the reverse process to condensation.
Evaporation is the reverse process to melting.
Evaporation is the reverse process to solidification.

cup 1 cup 2 cup 3

In which cup does the tea cool most quickly and in which cup does it cool most slowly?
most quickly most slowly
Why does a balloon filled with hot air rise?

options.text: Cold air is less dense than hot air.
Cold air is more dense than hot air.
Heat rises.
The density of the balloon is greater than the density of the surrounding gas.

options.text: the distance between one crest and the next crest
the distance that a crest moves along the surface in one second
the distance that a particle of water moves up and down
the number of waves that pass a fixed point in one second
